Q: How to create an array of empty lists A:

You can try (for fun)

>>> list(map(lambda x: [], l))
[[], [], [], [], []]

or

>>> list(map(lambda x: [x]*0, l))
[[], [], [], [], []]

Q: CSS hover state shows both normal text and hover state text (works fine on other pages) A:

The issue was not related to CSS hover styles.

On the affected page, the header component was rendered twice, which caused the menu text to exist multiple times in the DOM.
In normal state the duplicated elements overlapped, making it look correct, but on hover only one instance changed color, resulting in both normal and hover text appearing at the same time.

The duplication happened due to page-specific JavaScript initializing the header component more than once.

After ensuring the header component is rendered only once, the hover issue was resolved without any CSS changes.

Problem:
When visiting the default shop URL: https://airsoftlabs.ddev.site/ it immediately redirects to:
https://airsoftlabs.ddev.site/nl/?_locale=en_US

What I’ve done so far:

  • Configured sylius_shop.yaml with locale_switcher: url

  • Routes sylius_shop (default /) and sylius_shop_nl (/nl) are defined

  • Disabled the custom locale subscribers and RequestLocaleContext

  • Checked framework.yaml and translations.yaml to defaults

Still, the redirect happens and I can’t access the English home page without getting redirected.

Any advice to fix the default locale / without a redirect to /nl/?
